headlines.title: U.S. agencies say top Chinese AI companies systematically copied American models
headlines.description: In its most detailed accusation yet, the U.S. government has named six Chinese AI companies that it says copied American companies for their AI secrets.

headlines.title: Chinese hackers are running AI on stolen networks to avoid detection, Google says
headlines.description: One China-linked group targets academic, medical and military AI research, the report says.

headlines.title: Dolly Parton’s sister slams ‘fake AI garbage’ flooding the internet since icon’s death
headlines.description: Dolly Parton’s sister has condemned the AI deepfakes circulating in the wake of the beloved American icon’s death.

headlines.title: As Trump pushes for data centers, voters in key midterm races say they don’t want them
headlines.description: An NBC News Decision Desk Poll found that 69% of respondents oppose building AI data centers in their areas, with 45% saying they “strongly oppose” the idea.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze New Hampshire primary election results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in New Hampshire, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: Conflicting court rulings leave Missouri’s congressional map in limbo
headlines.description: Republicans rushed to the high court after the Missouri Supreme Court ruled the state could not use the redrawn map, which was designed to eliminate one Democratic-held seat, this year.

headlines.title: Tech company discloses first-of-its-kind A.I. cyberattack of one government against another
headlines.description: Israeli cyber security firm Dream says it disclosed an A.I. hack working to compromise a government entity in Asia, thousands of miles away. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: Best Apps to Simplify the Back-to-School Routine
headlines.description: As families are settling into the school year, a little tech can go a long way toward making that return to busy days a little more manageable. Tech expert Katie Linendoll joins TODAY with her favorite apps to help you get back in the swing of things, including SuperAlarm that puts you on a mission to complete tasks to stop the alarm, Libby, a free digital reading app, and more!

headlines.title: Rogue OpenAI agents hijacked German website, making more than 15,000 edits
headlines.description: A swarm of rogue OpenAI agents hijacked a German website back in May, making more than 15,000 edits and turning the site into a message board. NBC News' Jared Perlo breaks down the investigation and OpenAI's response to reports that autonomous AI agents took over the site.

headlines.title: Half of Americans Admit to Spending Too Much Time on Phones
headlines.description: A new study from the Pew Research Center showed that half of American adults admit they spend too much time on their phones, with 1-in-4 saying they are scrolling on their phones “almost constantly.” People under 30 had even higher numbers, with about 70% saying they should cut back on their usage.

headlines.title: Hundreds of teens swarm Colorado shopping center for so-called ‘takeover’
headlines.description: Hundreds of teens swarmed a shopping center in Colorado in what’s been dubbed a ‘‘takeover.’ It’s part of a growing trend where streets and businesses are overrun, usually organized on social media. NBC News' Steve Patterson reports.

headlines.title: Mamdani announces ban on AI for young students in NYC public schools
headlines.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani announced a one-year ban on artificial intelligence for students from 2-K through 8th grade in public schools. NBC News' Tyler Kingkade reports.
